{"parse":{"title":"2026–27 Cypriot First Division","pageid":83779371,"redirects":[],"wikitext":"{{Only primary sources|date=August 2026}} {{Infobox football league season | logo = | pixels = | season = 2026–27 | dates = 28 August 2026 – 23 May 2027 | country = Cyprus | winners = | relegated = | continentalcup1 = [[UEFA Champions League]] | continentalcup2 = [[UEFA Europa League]] | continentalcup3 = [[UEFA Conference League]] | matches = 7 | total goals = 22 | prevseason = [[2025–26 Cypriot First Division|2025–26]] | nextseason = [[2027–28 Cypriot First Division|2027–28]] | updated = 01 September 2026 | logo_alt = | logo_upright = | continentalcup1 spots = | continentalcup2 spots = | continentalcup3 spots = | total_goals = | league_topscorer = | biggest_home_win = | biggest_away_win = | highest_scoring = | longest_wins = | longest_unbeaten = | longest_winless = | longest_losses = | highest_attendance = | lowest_attendance = | average_attendance = }}The '''2026–27 Cypriot First Division''', known as the '''Cyprus League by Stoiximan''' for sponsorship reasons, is the 88th season of the [[Cyprus|Cypriot]] top-level [[Association football|football]] league since its establishment. [[AC Omonia|Omonia]] are the defending champions, having won their 22nd title in the [[2025–26 Cypriot First Division|2025–26 season]].{{cite web |date=24 July 2026 |title=Το πρόγραμμα της πρώτης φάσης της Cyprus League by Stoiximan περιόδου 2026 - 2027 |url=https://www.cfa.com.cy/Gr/news/53562 |access-date=24 July 2026 |publisher=Cyprus Football Association}} The draw for the first phase was held on 24 July 2026 at the Olympic House in Nicosia. The season begin 28 August 2026, and will conclude on the weekend of 22–23 May 2027.{{cite web |date=24 July 2026 |title=Το πρόγραμμα της πρώτης φάσης της Cyprus League by Stoiximan περιόδου 2026 - 2027 |url=https://www.cfa.com.cy/Gr/news/53562 |access-date=24 July 2026 |publisher=Cyprus Football Association}} Fourteen teams compete in the league — the eleven teams remaining from the previous season, and three teams promoted from the [[2025–26 Cypriot Second Division]]. == Team changes == {| class="wikitable" !Promoted from [[2025–26 Cypriot Second Division]] !Relegated from [[2025–26 Cypriot First Division]] |- |[[Nea Salamis Famagusta FC|Nea Salamina FC]] |[[Akritas Chlorakas]] |- |[[Karmiotissa FC|Karmiotissa]] |[[Ethnikos Achna FC|Ethnikos Achna]] |- |[[PAC Omonia 29M|Omonia 29M]] |[[Enosis Neon Paralimni FC|Enosis Neon Paralimni]] |} == Stadia and locations == {{location map+ |Cyprus |width=500 |float=right |caption=Locations of the '''2026–27 Cypriot First Division''' teams.|places= {{Location map~ |Cyprus |mark=TransparentPlaceholder.png |marksize=1 |lat=35.700000 |long=32.155557 |label_size=80|label={{nowrap|'''Nicosia teams:'''
